title: The Secret of the Sunstone Flower

beats.segment: Maya visited the city's big park. She needed to find the rare Sunstone Flower for her school project. She had a map, but the park was very large. She saw many tall trees and colorful birds, but no Sunstone Flower.
Maya looked closely at the map. She saw a small trail hidden behind some big rocks. She followed it carefully.
Walking down the hidden path, Maya found a beautiful glass house. Inside, the temperature was very warm. In the center, a bright yellow flower glowed like the sun.
Maya took out her camera and took a perfect photo for her project. She smiled. She learned that being patient helps you find beautiful things.
beats.endWrap: Maya finished her school project and discovered a magical new place.
